items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: He had quite a few people that he hired professionally that you knew were not amateurs

ctx.x: They used to call me Teeny, cause I was so small, but when we got to Washington I changed it myself to Tiny. Sounded a better pronunciation

We hung around Washington for the longest with this Wynken Blynken and Nod Thing gettin' nowhere. So we finally got to New York on a Major Bowes Show. That's quite a few years back -- Major Bowles. He had quite a few people that he hired professionally that you knew were not amateurs, you might say. He would spot them to kind of brighten up the show. So we were one of the groups. We traveled, you know, gettin' nothin' hardly, no money, just to have somethin' to do. We used to go & travel 3 or 4 towns. I was still…

So finally around 1939 or 40, I got a job with Dickie Wells's -- after hours spot didn't start until about 3 or 4 o'clock in the morning, after everything else was closed. So we had quite a bit of downtown trade, plenty. They used to come up and spend all kind of money. And it was with a tramp band, of all things, 8-piece tramp band. No horns, kazooks.
